{{Quote|Better watch out, there's a Jedi on the loose.|This droid speaking with two others|<ref name="Bombad Jedi">{{TCW|Bombad Jedi}}</ref>}}
A '''[[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]''' was stationed in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] during the subsequent [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|apprehension]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and served under command of [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]].

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], this [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] along with two others ambushed and apprehended [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] senator Padmé Amidala while she was speaking to [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]]. The senator then tried to contact her companions, [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] and [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], but one droid stopped her and destroyed her [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. She was then taken to the detention tower and this droid along with the other two guarded her until Nute Gunray arrived on the planet.

Later, the battle droids received a message that a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was loose in the city, which gave senator Amidala an idea. She pretended that a Jedi had come into her cell and freed her to lure one of the droids to open her cell. This droid believed her, opening her cell and walking inside, only to be overpowered by her moments later. The senator then fought and destroyed the other two battle droids and escaped.
